asset_manifests.title: Fossil Hunt: The Field Station
asset_manifests.visual_identity: An expansive 1:1 camp layout featuring a 'tent city' aesthetic. Includes a large mess tent, a dedicated equipment storage tent, and a prep-work tent with open flaps showing field laptops and fossils on tables. The orange canoe sits on a lakeside rack in the background.

infrastructure.status: Positioned away from tents to reduce noise

character_actions.action: Inside the prep tent, wearing his black aviator glasses, analyzing data on a laptop.
Unloading shale sheets (plant imprints) from the 4WD Pickup; wearing her pink blouse and sun hat.
Cleaning a large Apatosaurus femur on a work table in the prep tent; wearing his purple tee.
At the mess tent, organizing supplies; wearing her green sun hat and blouse.
Near the SUV, checking a Protoceratops egg specimen; wearing her red tee and shorts.
In the storage tent, organizing the jackhammer and rock saw; wearing her braids.
